title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam  highlighting the importance of determination and perseverance
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of determination and perseverance in achieving lasting success: सुव्याहृतानि धीराणां फलतः परिचिन्त्य यः। अध्यवस्यति कार्येषु चिरं यशसि तिष्ठति॥ The Subhashitam underscores that those who reflect upon the wise counsel of the learned and pursue their endeavours with determination and perseverance achieve lasting success and earn an enduring place in history. The Prime Minister posted on X: सुव्याहृतानि धीराणां फलतः परिचिन्त्य यः। अध्यवस्यति कार्येषु चिरं यशसि तिष्ठति॥ सुव्याहृतानि धीराणां फलतः परिचिन्त्य यः।

अध्यवस्यति कार्येषु चिरं यशसि तिष्ठति॥ https://t.co/3RvwoZcqSH — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 2, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/VJ
